# System76 Launch Heavy — Full-Size Open-Source Mechanical Keyboard

**Category:** Keyboard

**MSRP:** $299.00

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Layout | 105-key, full-size with numpad, ANSI US QWERTY |
| Chassis | System76 open-source milled aluminum chassis; detachable lift bar for 15° incline |
| Electronics | System76 open-source PCB design; individually addressable RGB LED backlighting; N-Key Rollover |
| Switch Sockets | Kailh MX Hotswap Sockets |
| Switch Options | Kailh Box Jade, Royal, Silent Pink, or Silent Brown |
| Keycaps | Doubleshot PBT, shine-through legends, Bobo profile |
| Custom Configuration | System76 Keyboard Configurator app (Linux, Windows, macOS) |
| Integrated USB Hub | 2x USB 3.2 Gen 2x1 Type-C (up to 10 Gbps), 2x USB 3.2 Gen 2x1 Type-A (up to 10 Gbps) |
| Firmware | System76 open-source QMK firmware |
| Connectivity | Wired, detachable USB cable (USB-C to USB-C and USB-A to USB-C included) |
| Dimensions | 15.51" x 5.32" x 1.19" (394 x 135.1 x 30.3 mm) |
| Weight | 2.8 lbs (1315.42 g) |
| Model | launch_heavy_3b |
| Warranty | 1 year limited parts and labor (3-year option available) |

## Notable Features

- Fully open-source hardware (chassis and PCB design published on GitHub) and open-source QMK firmware
- Hotswappable Kailh switches with a choice of tactile, clicky, or silent variants — no soldering required
- Split spacebar for remapping extra keys to a more convenient position
- Built-in high-speed USB hub with SuperSpeed USB-C and USB-A ports for fast peripheral/drive transfers
- Detachable magnetic lift bar for a 15° typing incline
- Designed, engineered, and manufactured in Denver, Colorado
- Lifetime support plus detailed repair/customization guides for swapping keys, switches, and LEDs
